newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to launch effort against child sexual exploitation.
newsitem.headline: EU to launch effort against child sexual exploitation.

text.p: The European Union said on Friday it would launch fresh initiatives to combat commercial sexual exploitation of children, which it called "a particularly evil and cruel modern-day form of slavery".

EU justice and home affairs ministers will seek to step up police and judicial cooperation to fight such crimes when they meet in Dublin on September 26 and 27, it said in a declaration issued by current Union president Ireland.
Action could be taken under the Europol convention, which established an EU policy agency, or under a special cooperation accord, it said.

The EU said it welcomed the outcome of the world congress on sexual exploitation of children in August in Stockholm and would work within the United Nations to ensure its recommendations were implemented.
It said it would continue working to make traffic in human beings a criminal offence internationally.
